convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorZerolagDeMarker custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position opening/closing logic. Multi-component custom oscillator with weighted sum calculation requires custom indicator replication.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal triggers close of existing position via BUY_Close/SELL_Close flags before opening new position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means MM is fixed lot size; other MarginMode values treat MM as deposit fraction for risk-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: Zero-lag DeMarker is a weighted composite of 5 DeMarker oscillators with factors (0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43) applied to periods (8,21,34,55,89). The indicator has 2 buffers: buffer0 is the main oscillator line, buffer1 is the signal/trigger line. Entry signal requires a crossover between bar[SignalBar] and bar[SignalBar-1] (i.e. confirmed crossover on a historical bar, default bar 1). Signal is only evaluated on new bars (NB.IsNewBar) or when Recount is triggered due to CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean input gates allowing user to independently enable/disable each direction of entry and exit. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to position open functions uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, suggesting the trade library may use this for pending order timing or signal validity checks.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the ColorZerolagDeMarker custom indicator logic: calculate 5 standard DeMarker indicators with periods 8,21,34,55,89, weight each by Factor1-5, sum the weighted values, then apply smoothing (EMA period 15) to produce buffer0. Buffer1 is likely a signal line (EMA of buffer0 or similar) - exact logic requires reading the custom indicator source. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/GlobalVariableDel_/LoadHistory/CIsNewBar - these must be reimplemented or replaced with standard Python broker API equivalents. The MM input with MarginMode enum supports both fixed lot and deposit-fraction sizing - need to replicate this dual-mode logic. Signal bar parameter (default=1) means signals are read from the previous completed bar, not the current forming bar - ensure Python backtest aligns with this convention. Deviation parameter (10 points) is used as slippage tolerance in trade functions.
